answer: In PoA, each agent’s reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so only sustained honest service preserves weight in the EigenTrust matrix. A freshly spawned sybil begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality, has no trusted incoming mass, and cannot pass consensus; reciprocity-weighted transitivity amplifies established links, while sable, zenith, and delta remain irrelevant without durable, corroborated behavior.
